'''Shann Childsen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|officer]] who served onboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Prisoner transfer from cell block 1138.''"''<br />''"''I wasn't notified. I'll have to clear it.|Luke Skywalker and Shann Childsen shortly before the former shoots the latter|<ref name="ANH" />}}
Shann Childsen joined the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ANH" /> His personality and dislike towards certain [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species gained him a reputation as a bully by his fellow [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]]. At some point he was demoted after a superior blamed him for a clerical error, however, Childsen's fanatical support of the New Order assisted in his selection as a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]], and thus saved his career in the Imperial Navy. He eventually achieved the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]].<ref name="Childsen TCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Lt. Shann Childsen}}</ref>

In 0 BBY, he was in command of [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention Block AA-23]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|infiltrated]] the battlestation to rescue [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Solo and Skywalker disguised themselves as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and made their way to Detention Block AA-23 with Chewbacca in tow, wearing [[Binders/Legends|binders]] in order to appear as a "[[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]." Upon the trio exiting a turbolift into the detention block, Childsen, standing at a [[Command sector duty post|duty post]] asked Skywalker where they were taking the Wookiee, to which he responded that it was a prisoner transport from [[Cell Block 1138/Legends|cell block 1138]]. Childsen was suspicious and claimed that he wasn't notified; he ordered two nearby [[Death Star Trooper/Legends|Death Star troopers]] to draw their blasters and grab the Wookiee while he attempted to contact another Imperial to verify the transfer.<ref name="ANH" />

[[File:DeathStarShootOut.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Shann Childsen drawing his blaster.]]
As one of the Death Star troopers approached Chewbacca, the Wookiee subsequently broke out of the binders and knocked the trooper to the side. Childsen, seeing this, reached for his blaster, but was shot and killed by Skywalker as he pulled it out. A gunfight ensued between the infiltrators and the Death Star troopers in the detention block, that ended with the troopers killed and several security cameras destroyed. After the shooting had finished, Skywalker and Solo ran to the duty post, where Childsen's body had slumped over. Skywalker removed it while Solo checked to see which cell Princess Leia was in.<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Childsen was a light skinned, human male with brown hair.<ref name="ANH" /> He was considered a bully by fellow officers and was an ardent believer in the [[New Order/Legends|New Order's]] [[High Human Culture/Legends|anti-alien policies]].<ref name="Childsen TCG" /> Childsen particularly disliked such "primitive" [[Species/Legends|species]] as [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Talz/Legends|Talz]], and [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
Childsen wore the [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|uniform]] of a security officer, which consisted of a black tunic, duty belt, and cap. The tunic had a [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]] in each breast pocket, and a [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia plaque]] made up of four blue squares in a single row that sat on the left side of the chest part. He carried a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lt. Childsen was portrayed by [[Malcolm Tierney]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']]. According to the Star Wars IMDB Trivia Page, Tierney's voice was dubbed over.
